1. BOOKSHOP SALE — Selected books are half-price today. A £6 book now costs £3. Other books keep their usual price.

2. Hi Dad, these shoes are too small. Can we try on the next size? Please meet me by the front door. Jo

3. SUPERMARKET — Keep your receipt if you want to return something. Ask a shop assistant for help.

4. TOY DEPARTMENT — This shelf is for sale items only. Please leave full-price toys on the other shelves.

5. MARKET NEWS — We close at four today, one hour earlier than usual. Please finish your shopping before then.

6. LOST WALLET — Found beside the changing rooms. Tell the shop assistant its colour to receive it.
